entries.source: Basic tactic: Do not get surrounded
As unpleasant-looking as any exposed organ.
entries.target: 像其他解剖的器官一样，这个肾脏很难看。

entries.source: %s feels the pain of the death blow!
entries.target: %s 感受到了死亡一击的疼痛！

entries.source: A poem written in scribbled, child-like writing
entries.target: 像小孩子写的潦草诗歌

entries.source: A severed naga tongue. It reeks of brine.
entries.target: 一截娜迦的舌头。它散发着海水的气息。

entries.source: Wickedly sharp and still freezing cold.
entries.target: 异乎寻常的锋利且散发着阵阵寒气。
#LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔法，+5 意志，+4 灵巧

entries.source:
Green-skinned and ugly, this massive humanoid glares at you, clenching wart-covered green fists.
He looks hurt.
entries.target:
绿皮丑陋，这只巨大的人形生物正盯着你，握紧了满是肉瘤的绿色拳头。
他看起来受伤了。

entries.source: Diseased-looking and reeking. It seems to be decaying as you watch.
entries.target: 病变且散发着恶臭的心脏，在你注视它时似乎仍在腐烂。

entries.source: Terrain prevents #Source# from switching places with #Target#.
This pedestal looks old, you can see the shape of an orb carved on it.
entries.target: 这个基座看上去很古老，你能看到上面铭刻着一个水晶球的图案。

entries.source: Do you wish to disturb the grave?
entries.target: 你想要挖掘这个坟墓吗？
确认忽略所有来自%s的消息

entries.source: It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.
entries.target: 它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——不时闪着光芒。
